key_insight: CF-HM combines cutting and friction stir welding in a repeated plate-building process aimed at high-efficiency, high-precision, low-cost metal additive manufacturing.
engineering_relevance: The method uses a general machining center, offering a potential route to metal additive manufacturing without dedicated AM equipment.
method: Feed metal plates to build the part incrementally.
Join plates by friction stir welding and shape them by cutting.
Integrate countermeasures for four identified FSW-related problems.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports development of CF-HM and countermeasures for four problems, but provides no quantitative efficiency, precision, cost, or joint-quality results.
watch_item: The claimed advantages require quantitative validation, particularly for weld integrity across repeated plate interfaces.
paper_title: Development of high-efficiency high-precision low-cost metal AM method “Cutting and Friction-stir-welding Hybrid Manufacturing (CF-HM)”
